subject: Artificial Turf and Playground Surfacing
overview: The committee heard a detailed presentation from city staff on the health, environmental, and accessibility tradeoffs of artificial turf and poured-in-place playground rubber. Members also discussed municipal energy aggregation, smart meters, and a volunteer tracking framework for the Climate Action Plan.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the December minutes as written and the January minutes with a typographical correction.

items.title: Artificial Turf and Playground Surfacing
items.summary: Open Space Planner Amanda Centrella reviewed the maintenance demands, heat absorption, accessibility factors, and PFAS chemical risks of artificial turf fields and poured-in-place playground surfaces. Committee members discussed procurement specifications to avoid PFAS, infill alternatives, and the ecological impacts of synthetic installations.

items.title: City Sustainability and Energy Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on resolving electricity aggregation mailing errors, evaluating automatic low-income enrollment, fielding concerns about National Grid smart meters and opt-out fees, and preparing solar grant applications for local schools.

items.title: Climate Action Plan Tracking Framework
items.summary: Josh Ekhart-Lee presented a spreadsheet tool designed for committee volunteers to liaise with municipal stewards and quantitatively track progress on individual Climate Action Plan objectives.

items.title: Committee Announcements and New Business
items.summary: Members shared information regarding an upcoming forum on the Tufts Park mini-forest, volunteer opportunities for municipal pollinator gardens, and plans to take up recommendations on takeout containers and black plastics at the next meeting.
